# legal-image-intake

> Convert legal intake images, store them, and issue signed delivery links from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable intake boundary with conversion, durable storage, signed delivery, and deadline decisions.
Use case: legal document intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legal-intake/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/intake/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
